findings.title: Robots blocks newly managed public images
findings.evidence: All public/search groups disallow /api/ while new media paths are /api/media/<id>.
findings.proposed: Allow the exact media delivery prefix or choose a public delivery route while preserving server/database authorization and 404 for private media.

findings.title: Legacy large image preview permission is not preserved
findings.evidence: 153 source posts have max-image-preview:large; current metadata functions do not transport it.
findings.proposed: Preserve appropriate public preview directives with restrictive admin overrides.

findings.kind: Editorial trust gap; legacy preserved, not automatic content rewrite
findings.title: Medical article authors need verified identity and context
findings.evidence: All 153 visible authors are legacy Johny; no verified author profile or medical review linkage.
findings.proposed: Clinic verifies real authors/reviewers before any byline/schema change.

findings.title: Parent MedicalClinic node lacks LocalBusiness address
findings.evidence: Parent node has name/url but no address; separate units have addresses.
findings.proposed: Model parent as MedicalOrganization/Organization and physical units as MedicalClinic, or confirm the represented unit before assigning an address.

findings.title: WordPress sample page remains public and suggested in sitemap
findings.evidence: Sample Page English template preserved; sitemap maps every institutional page.
findings.proposed: Record approved page disposition before excluding it from public/index/sitemap; preserve historical source.

findings.title: Optional website name, alt, description and breadcrumb refinements
findings.evidence: No WebSite node, 15 body images lack alt, 111 body images have empty alt; decorative images require classification.
findings.proposed: Add accurate WebSite, review informative image alts and descriptions with client; omit unnecessary one-item Home breadcrumb.

findings.title: Imported HTML entities are retained as literal SEO text
findings.evidence: 117 canonical metadata descriptions and BlogPosting descriptions still contain escaped source entities such as ….
findings.proposed: Decode source-encoded metadata once at the import/snapshot legacy boundary while preserving literal editorial input and raw source evidence; reconcile existing hosted records explicitly before any migration write.

conclusion: Technical base verified offline; one P1, five P2 and one P3 finding pending; HTTP/published indexing validation not complete.
